curated_items.title: How Deutsche Telekom is rewiring telecommunications with AI
curated_items.summary: In this customer story, Jonathan Abrahamson, Chief Product & Digital Officer at Deutsche Telekom, shares how the company is reimagining telecommunications with AI—transforming employee workflows, customer service, network operations, and the future of voice. Hear how Deutsche Telekom is working toward becoming an AI-native telecommunications company, bringing AI into communications experiences through capabilities such as live translation, in-call assistants, and automated summarization, while redesigning how work gets done across the business. Read the full Deutsche Telekom story: https://openai.com/index/deutsche-telekom/
